people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

people.name: Sodom
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins

translations.web: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
translations.bsb: They also carried off Abram’s nephew Lot and his possessions, since Lot was living in Sodom.
translations.kjv: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
